build_commands: npm_config_engine_strict=false && NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=6144" && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build

auto_profile.summary: A secure, open-source media management platform for organizing and sharing photos and videos.
auto_profile.description: Immich is a privacy-focused media management application that allows users to store, organize, and share photos and videos. It supports end-to-end encryption, automatic metadata extraction, and advanced search features. The application includes a web interface, mobile apps, and a backend service for managing media files and user accounts. It is built on a modern stack of Node.js, TypeScript, and Svelte, with support for machine learning-based features for image analysis and metadata extraction.

port.description: The port the application listens on.
